sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
title block.

The present 
electric hydraulic governor system represents the latest development in a 
continuing program designed to provide the best equipment available for 
hydraulic turbine speed control --- the hydraulic turbine governor is no longer 
just a speed response control of the turbine control of the turbine .

The first draft initiated & tested by 
eng. Khaled Saeed Mohamed , reviewed by eng. Hamdy El Abd Ahmed Zahran, accepted by general director eng.Nagy Nageeb 
Saleh and approved by eng Mohamed Abdel Baset head sector of Aswan dam (1&2) 
hydraulic Power Stations and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakim HPGC MPIS 
Coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued, the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be well trained qualified or directly supervised by 
 the some one who is
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear the safety and healthy protective 
 equipment as safety shoes, helmet . etc.
Unit out of service.
قم بإيقاف تشغيل مصدر طاقة التيار المستمر قبل إدخال المرحل أو سحبه

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات

Signal generator variable from 0 5000 Hz , and minimum 6 to 8 volt 
 ( r.m.s )

Electric frequency counter to accurately set the signal generator output to 
 the desired frequency
Multi - range DC voltmeter

A good oscilloscope and digital voltmeter are very handly to have, although 
 not always necessary

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
تحضير
Turn off governor power supply.
اسحب جميع الوحدات من الرفوف.
Turn on the governor power supply transfer switch to the test position.
Check the main supply ( AC DC ).

items: Turn off governor power supply.
اسحب جميع الوحدات من الرفوف.
Turn on the governor power supply transfer switch to the test position.
Check the main supply ( AC DC ).

sections.text: إجراءات

Turn the potentiometer (P1, P2, P3, P4) which are located in the power supply 
 monitor board fully counter clockwise

Adjust the +15 Vdc supply to +14.5 Vdc . Adjust P1 clockwise until +15 V 
 supply indicated light goes out

Adjust the +12 Vdc supply to +11.5 Vdc . Adjust P2 clockwise until +12 V 
 supply indicated light goes out

Adjust the +5 Vdc supply to + 4.75 Vdc . Adjust P3 clockwise until +5 V 
 supply indicated light goes out

Adjust the -15 Vdc supply to -14.5 Vdc . Adjust P4 clockwise until -15 V 
 supply indicated light goes out .

sections.text:
Calibration of Crowbar 
Circuit

Adjust the regulator to the desired crowbar set voltage , slowly turn the 
 crowbar .adjust counter clockwise until the voltage drop suddenly , shut off 
 the power , and turn back the voltage

Adjust some what so the 
 crowbar will not clamp the voltage when power supply is reapplied , the 
 volatge regulator then may be calibrated for the specified voltage output.
